language.name: High Elven Court Speech
language.purpose: Original constructed language for formal Elven speech in Kael-Vossen.
design_rules: Vocabulary must not be built by repeatedly recycling a small set of fantasy syllables.
Words should not accidentally resemble ordinary English/Common words when a distinct form is possible.
Romanization is the manuscript-facing representation; the native script is separately defined.
Meaning should remain understandable through context even when a reader does not know the language.
Formal court speech, military speech, casual speech, insults, and ritual language may use different registers.
Existing manuscript meanings are preserved when the database expands the language.

alphabet.name: Veyrath
alphabet.principle: A flowing angular script designed for inscription on living wood, crystal, metal, and ceremonial cloth.
alphabet.romanization: Latin characters are used for manuscript typing and translator data until the native glyph set is finalized.
alphabet.note: Glyph shapes are not yet locked; do not treat Roman letters as the in-world alphabet.

phonotactic_notes: Prefer varied consonant clusters and vowel patterns rather than repeated templates.
Formal words may contain longer internal clusters; casual speech may shorten them.
Avoid using English-looking standalone words as core vocabulary.

grammar.default_word_order: verb-subject-object in formal declarations; flexible order in conversation
notes: Formal speech favors explicit titles and evidential precision.
Possession and rank should be represented through dedicated grammatical particles rather than English-style apostrophe construction.
Questions use rising syntax and interrogative particles rather than relying only on English word order.

translator.notes: Only confirmed or deliberately introduced mappings should be added here.
